label: November 30–December 6, 2026
intro: Father's Day Saturday (Dec 5): a Danish Christmas bazaar with Santa, gingerbread house building, and robots at the VEX competition.

activities.title: Kimpton Maa-Lai gingerbread house workshop — opening weekend
activities.location: Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, 78 Soi Tonson, Lumphini
activities.why: A building project you can eat: he constructs and decorates his own gingerbread house and takes it home. Building & making, Christmas edition.
activities.tip: Book at least 2 days ahead. Perfect Father's Day activity on Dec 5.

activities.title: Danish Christmas Bazaar with Santa
activities.location: Gaysorn Urban Resort, Chit Lom BTS
activities.why: Santa photos, a creative kids' corner and Danish treats. Very festive, very easy.
activities.tip: Combine with the CentralWorld rink next door for an ice-skating + Santa day.

activities.title: VEX Robotics Signature Event (spectating)
activities.why: Big robots built by students battling on a field. A future Tony Stark's dream to watch.
activities.tip: It's a student competition, so confirm public access with the school first.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — weeknight river lights
activities.location: 13 riverside spots along the Chao Phraya
activities.why: Light-mapped temples and glowing buildings on a ferry ride. Magic for a school-night treat.
activities.tip: An orange-flag ferry hop between piers gives the best views.

activities.title: ICONSIAM Bangkok Illumination — giant golden Christmas tree
activities.why: 21-metre golden tree and riverside lights, with Vijit shows on the river right next to it.
activities.tip: Go at dusk for both shows in one trip.
